_README: Institutional library electronic-resource proxy (off-campus access) profiles.
This file exists only to build 'links for a human to click'. This toolkit
does not log into the proxy itself, and does not auto-download the full
Why no auto-download — Korea University Library's 'Electronic Resources
Fair Use' policy names, as the first listed violation:
'Downloading full text by electronic or mechanical means (a download
program, engine, robot, macro, RPA, etc.)'
Even when a script picks up after a legitimate personal login, the means
itself is the violation. The sanction is a one-year library-service
Other institutions generally carry the same clause — check that
institution's own policy directly before adding an entry.
How to add an entry: put a {url} placeholder in proxy_url_template.
Add it only after actually opening it once in a browser and confirming it
works (an unverified template silently produces a broken link).
Never put credentials (ID/password) in this file. Login is done by a

korea-univ.login_note: You must log in to the library homepage first for the link to open. Eligibility is tied to enrollment/affiliation status, borrowing privileges, and any overdue holds.

daily_limits._note: Library guideline. Exceeding it can be detected by publisher monitoring and get the whole institutional IP range blocked.

korea-univ._verified_how: Confirmed the template and policy wording by reading the guide/ and notice/ pages directly.
